summary: Reviewed the full c2ab055..HEAD diff: removal of *exec.Cmd from QualityVariant with variantMu-published pid, removal of ffmpegDone's racy Cmd.ProcessState signal, cmd.WaitDelay with the ErrWaitDelay carve-out, and the variantWaitDelay test seam. Reproduced the original race at base and confirmed it gone; ran all four acceptance criteria (race suites, full build/vet/test with real ffmpeg 6.1.1 and AURORA_REQUIRE_MEDIA_TESTS=1); enumerated every tm.mu/variantMu nesting in the file and confirmed no inversion; enumerated every variantWaitDelay read and confirmed production reads it only on the caller's goroutine; killed all 8 requested mutants, each by the test whose comment claims it; -race -count=5 -shuffle=on and a CPU-saturated run for flakiness; fact-checked comment claims against Go 1.26.5 os/exec and testing source. No critical, high or medium findings. Two lows, neither a defect: the documented pre-existing cmd.Start()-failure path that never sets exited, and that the reaper-cancel test pins the ctx.Err() arm rather than the WaitDelay drain (which matches its own comment; reviewer confirmed no further coverage needed). Earlier rounds 1-5 found and fixed: an overclaiming ffmpegDone comment, a stranded-variant regression from losing the ProcessState escape hatch, two test-coverage gaps on the crash decision, and a data race in the test seam itself.
